findings.topic: WORST GAP — Lingikogu links reorder (#256, NEW since stale inventory)
findings.fact: src/routes/links/+page.svelte:181-203 (move/moveUp/moveDown -> lib/links/linkActions.ts reorderLinks). Trigger: click up/down arrow buttons -- fires immediately, no separate save action, this IS auto-save. NOT optimistic and has ZERO of the four states: (1) no pending flag anywhere in this file -- disabled={i===0}/{i===rows.length-1} is a boundary check only, never a write-in-flight guard, so nothing stops a double-tap firing two concurrent reorders against the same atomic-overwrite wire (#264); (2) no 'saving' indicator; (3) on success, `rows` only updates via refreshRows(cfg) -- so there's a visible delay with no busy signal; (4) on FAILURE, the catch block (move():190-191) does ONLY console.error -- refreshRows is never called on the failure path, so the row list simply does not re-render and the user sees literally nothing happen, no error text, no role=alert, no retry hint. findings.topic: 3. Sub-issue conventions — API shape, house body shape, team-cut attribution precedent
findings.fact: API shape (verified live against GitHub's REST docs this turn): Add = `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}/sub_issues` body `{"sub_issue_id": <integer>, "replace_parent": <bool, optional>}`. Load-bearing gotcha, confirmed live this turn: `sub_issue_id` is the issue's internal database id, NOT its number (`gh api repos/mvox-dev/mvox-app/issues/322 --jq '{number,id}'` → `{"id":5419737836,"number":322}`) — every child needs an id lookup before the POST. List = `GET .../issues/{issue_number}/sub_issues`, per_page default 30 / max 100 — bentham.md already logged a real bug from this exact endpoint being called unpaginated on a 35-child epic ([GOTCHA-ONE-ENDPOINT-PAGINATES-ITS-SIBLING-DOES-NOT], 2026-09-10). #316's own natives (#317/#318/#319, later #320) were added this way (research-316.json r319 finding 6: `gh api .../316/sub_issues` lists them, `.../316 --jq .sub_issues_summary` shows total:3); the `sub_issue_added` timeline actor on #316 is `mitselek` for all three — GH author identity does NOT distinguish PO-cut from team-cut, only the body trailer does. Body house shape (identical for PO- and team-cut issues): YAML frontmatter `slugline`/`lead` in Estonian, English markdown body (## sections, Done-when, Not-in-scope), closing attribution trailer. PO-cut issues close `(*PO:Gama*)` (#289, #316, #320, #321 all confirmed this turn). TEAM-CUT precedent: **#322** ('Rights doc: ER-9 restated direction-free, ER-12's positional citation becomes ER-7') — read in full this turn: identical frontmatter+body shape, closes `(*MVOX:Palestrina*)`, states it was 'ruled by PO on #316' (Gama authorized in conversation; the team lead filed the issue) and deliberately declines to be a sub-issue of anything ('Deliberately NOT a #316 sub-issue') — so it pins the ATTRIBUTION convention but is not itself a worked sub_issues-API example. Direct confirmation that #289's children are meant as team-lead-cut native sub-issues: session-mvox19-pickup-log.md:32 'cut tasks as NATIVE sub-issues (GraphQL sub-issue links), NOT a markdown checklist'; team-lead.md:27 '...cut sub-issues as NATIVE sub-issue links (Gama: board indents from native links only)'; #289's own body, Tasks section close: 'The inventory genuinely gates the rest ... The remote team-lead cuts the concrete issues.'
